title: OpenID Connect (SSO)
intro: Sign in with an identity provider — Authentik, Keycloak, Auth0, Google, Microsoft Entra, and more.
redirectNote: Register this redirect URI with your provider: {uri}. Changing the button label needs a restart.
trustEmail: Trust email addresses from this provider
trustEmailNote: An email the provider has not marked as verified is never used to link an existing account or to pass the domain check. Turn this on only for a provider that checks addresses but does not say so, such as Microsoft Entra.

oidc.description: Sign in with an OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, Keycloak, Auth0, Google, Entra, and more).
